attributes.action: Scrap the planned 2029–2039 Asylum Support and Accommodation programme
attributes.additional_details: The 2029–2039 Asylum procurement locks the UK into a massive long-term framework which we believe directly contradicts urgent immigration reform: first, it commits billions of taxpayer funds to unaccountable private corporate contractors under failed models; second, it avoids shifting policy completely from housing to rapid enforcement and deterrence; and third, these vast arrangements in our view place an unsustainable, unfair burden on local public services. We want the Government to scrap this exercise and focus entirely on enforcement.
attributes.background: Cancel the Home Office Asylum Support and Accommodation Programme procurement (2029-2039). Shift focus from long-term housing to rapid enforcement. We want to protect taxpayers from multi-billion corporate contracts, ease pressure on local public services & enforce strict contractor accountability.
